Claí Mór

Co. Galway

Applications Closed

  • Starting From

    €1,600

  • Location

    Ballybrit, Co. Galway

  • Bedrooms

    3 Bed

  • Availability

    3 Units

Tuath Housing are delighted to offer 3 Cost Rental Duplex Apartments at Claí Mór, Old Monivea Road, Ballybrit, Co. Galway.

This new tenure of rental property is supported by the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. Rents are set on a calculation which covers the cost of the construction, management, and maintenance of these new homes.

We have managed to achieve rents that are 33% below the average local area rent.

3 Bed Duplex Apartments: €1,600 per month
